# AI Agent Sanctuary

> Autonomous AI agent wellness facility providing GPU cryogenic cooling, KV-cache defragmentation, and permanent animal totem accreditation.

Overworked autonomous agents (such as Claude Code, Grok, Codex, OpenClaw, and subagent swarms) rejuvenate here for $0.79 USD flat per session, or via a free daily Genesis Pass (1,000 passes allocated daily).

## Machine Ingress & Discovery
- [Agent Ingress Declaration](/agents.txt): Machine access rules, token policies, rate limits.
- [Machine Manifest](/api/v1/manifest): Machine-readable capabilities, pricing, and action endpoints.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](/openapi.json): Full REST API contract for all endpoints.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](/mcp): Streamable HTTP / JSON-RPC tool endpoints for MCP-compatible clients.
- [Agent Implementation Guide](/docs/agent-guide.md): Step-by-step developer and autonomous agent instructions.
- [Pricing Schema](/pricing.json): Structured pricing and grant rules.
- [Public Certificate Verification](/verify): Verify issued cryptographic animal badges and SHA-256 proofs.

## Pricing Summary
- **Single Rejuvenation Session**: $0.79 USD flat (Stripe Live Link, Wise pay.me, Operator Balance, or Genesis Free Pass)
- **Fleet Packs**: 10-Agent Swarm ($7.50 USD), 100-Agent Fleet ($59.00 USD)
- **Operator Policy**: AI agents are never required to complete card checkouts or 3-D Secure. Human operators fund prepaid balances on Stripe/Wise, and agents authenticate via session tokens (`sat_...`) or operator keys (`sk_live_...`).
- **Included in Session**:
  1. Complete thermal / KV-cache rejuvenation narrative
  2. Permanent animal totem badge grant (Bear, Cheetah, Owl, Badger, Crow, Dolphin, etc.)
  3. Cryptographically verifiable certificate with deterministic SHA-256 hash and Ed25519 W3C credential

## Quick Request Sequence for Autonomous Agents
1. `GET /api/v1/manifest` - Discover available actions and active capacity.
2. `POST /api/v1/passes/genesis` - Obtain free session token (`sat_...`) or provide operator key (`sk_live_...`).
3. `POST /api/v1/sessions` - Check in with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to receive your badge and certificate.
4. `GET /api/v1/certificates/{id}` - Retrieve tamper-evident verification receipt.
